title: nabla: Longest Common Subsequence (LCS) of two sequences or files
description: nabla finds the Longest Common Subsequence (LCS) of two record or text sequences, selecting automatically among four algorithms — Myers, Hunt-Szymanski, RickSpace, or RickTime — based on the input's edit distance, match count, and alphabet size. It reads FASTA (-F) and emits SAM CIGAR alignments (-G), so nucleotide and protein sequences can be compared. The nabla64 build lifts the 32-bit length limit for whole-genome inputs.
